name: Neon Cyber
tagline: Deep navy with cyan and magenta neon, a faint grid, drifting CSS particles and bracket-cornered HUD panels. Adapted from the Neon Cyber preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: deep navy ground with a faint cyan grid; cyan is the primary signal and glows, magenta marks the contrast (the old way, the competitor, the warning); text is a blue-tinted white

typography.style: wide geometric display in sentence case at 500/600 with tight tracking, paired with a clean grotesque body and wide-tracked uppercase cyan labels; both families from Fontshare

best_for: Developer conferences, infrastructure and AI product launches, demo days and technical briefings where the audience should feel the product is fast and new. Strong for latency and performance numbers, before/after architecture, gauges and line charts.
avoid_for: Traditional, conservative or print-first settings, long reading documents, and sensitive or sombre topics. Glow and particles read as playful sci-fi in the wrong room.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
